scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run check:css
scripts.check:css: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),g=fs.readdirSync('dist/assets').find(f=>f.endsWith('.css'));const c=fs.readFileSync('dist/assets/'+g,'utf8');const bad=c.includes('{ ')||c.includes('; ');if(bad){console.error('CSS did not fully minify - a rule earlier in the file is malformed');process.exit(1)}console.log('css ok')"
